title: 晓出净慈寺送林子方
pinyin: Xiǎo Chū Jìng Cí Sì Sòng Lín Zǐfāng
englishTitle: Leaving Jingci Temple at Dawn to See Lin Zifang Off
author: Yang Wanli

translation: after all, it is mid-summer at west lake
the scenery here is unlike any other season
lotus leaves reach the sky in endless green
lotus flowers glow in the sun a special red

appreciation: Written as a farewell to a friend, the poem never mentions parting and instead fills the eye with West Lake in midsummer. Green lotus leaves run to the horizon and the flowers burn red against the sun. The vast, colour-saturated scene made these lines the classic picture of Hangzhou's lotus season.
